title: FontVibe Fancy Text: 120 Unicode text styles as language-neutral pipelines, with a reverse normalisation table
description:
120 Unicode "fancy text" styles — mathematical alphanumerics, enclosed alphanumerics, small caps, superscript and subscript, upside-down, combining-mark styles, deterministic zalgo, lookalike scripts, braille, morse, Wingdings and case conversions — each defined as a short pipeline of steps in JSON, precise enough to reimplement in any language.

Dependency-free JavaScript and Python implementations are included and tested against a golden file captured from FontVibe's production code; both reproduce it exactly. A reverse (de-fancify) table maps styled characters back to plain ASCII and records, for every entry, whether Unicode NFKC normalisation already handles it and whether the character is a real letter in some script.

Every figure in the README is recomputed by scripts/verify.py (standard library only), which fails if the README disagrees with the data. Also distributed as unicode-text-styles on npm and PyPI. The live version is at fontvibe.ai/tools/fancy-font-generator.
